answer: Each epoch demands a fresh attestation from the issuer, and stale or copied records fail the check. Forging 243 of these means fabricating 243 separate authority-backed records, and each one must survive a live registry check. Proof comes from goldsmith hallmark registration: a registration the assay office renews after hallmarked pieces. Watch the marble: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the pulse bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the jade audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
